title: 第23章 这该死的恋爱酸臭味第24章 跟柳盈盈约会
slug: 都市修仙五年下山就无敌
content_zh:
柳盈盈没有回答。
她望了一眼在后院，陪伴女儿玩耍的叶凡，坐在妹妹身旁，关心问道：
“是不是发生了什么事，他欺负你了？”
“怎么可能。”
柳依依眨眨眼，促狭笑道：“就是单纯想跟你聊聊，姐，你该不会是害羞了吧。”
柳盈盈无言。
她一个当妈的人有什么好害羞的，又不是十六七岁说句话牵个手就会脸红的年纪。
“跟我讲讲你们的故事呗。”
柳依依十分亲昵抱着柳盈盈，脑袋在她脖颈间蹭来蹭去，像是一只小猫。
“大夏天的你干嘛，怪热的。”
“也不知道是谁小时候怕黑，非要跟我一块睡，那时候就不怕热了？”
“行行行，你要是想听，就给我坐好。”
柳盈盈扶额道。
柳依依瞬间坐好，顺便拿起西瓜吃了起来，标准的吃瓜观众。
“高一那年，学校组织郊外踏青，我不小心失足掉入湖里，老师同学全愣住了，就只有叶凡奋不顾身跳湖救我。”
“标准的英雄救美啊。”
柳依依说完，突然一愣，好像昨天也是这样，自己深陷绝境之中，叶凡像是天降神兵般出现。
“后来我发现叶凡偶尔在学校食堂帮工兼职，就为了省点吃饭钱。”
“为了报答救命之恩，我就每天多买一个鸡蛋两个包子跟牛奶给他。他不要，我说我买多了吃不完只能丢掉，他就不再拒绝了。”
“嘶。”

柳依依倒吸一口凉气。
难怪叶凡沦陷的这么深，这种照顾青春期小男生面子的女孩，哪个男人能不爱啊。
她忍不住鼓掌道：“老姐，以前总觉得你傻白甜，没想到你段位还挺高的。”
柳盈盈茫然道：“什么段位，我不会玩游戏。”
“……没事了，老姐你继续。”
“我呢，当时就是个沉默寡言的书呆子，叶凡学习好长得帅，有不少女生喜欢他，她们总是放学后来找我麻烦，有一次被叶凡看到了，他就每天骑着自行车接送我。”
“后来我才知道，他狠狠骂了那几个女生一顿，还偷偷从校外带我最爱吃的糖葫芦，他笨兮兮的，每次都会把衣服弄脏，害得我还要给他洗。”
“听起来有点浪漫啊。”
柳依依神色艳羡。
呜呜呜，这该死的恋爱酸臭味！
“浪漫？叶凡钢铁直男，不知道送花也不会说情话，给我写的情书全是三角形。”
content_en:
Liu Yingying did not answer.
She glanced at Ye Fan, who was playing with her daughter in the backyard, sat next to her sister, and asked with concern:
"Did something happen and he bullied you?"
"How is that possible?"
Liu Yiyi blinked and said with a narrow smile: "I just want to chat with you, sister, you must be shy, right?"
Liu Yingying was speechless.
What is there for her to be shy about as a mother? She is not at the age of sixteen or seventeen where she would blush just by holding hands.
"Tell me your story."
Liu Yiyi hugged Liu Yingying very affectionately, rubbing his head on her neck like a kitten.
"What are you doing in the summer? It's so hot."
"I wonder who was afraid of the dark when she was a child and insisted on sleeping with me. Then she was no longer afraid of the heat?"
"Okay, okay, if you want to listen, just sit down for me."
Liu Yingying held her forehead and said.
Liu Yiyi sat down instantly, picked up the watermelon and started eating it, just like a standard melon-eating audience.
"In my freshman year of high school, the school organized an outing in the countryside. I accidentally slipped and fell into the lake. My teachers and classmates were all stunned. Only Ye Fan risked his life and jumped into the lake to save me."
"A standard hero saving a beauty."
After Liu Yiyi finished speaking, she was suddenly stunned. It seemed like it was the same yesterday. She was in a desperate situation, and Ye Fan appeared like a divine soldier from heaven.
"Later I discovered that Ye Fan occasionally worked part-time as a helper in the school cafeteria, just to save some money for food."
"In order to repay his life-saving grace, I bought him an extra egg, two buns and milk every day. He didn't want it, so I told him that I had to throw it away because I bought too much and couldn't finish it. He stopped refusing."
"Hiss."
Liu Yiyi took a breath of cold air.
No wonder Ye Fan fell into such a deep trap. How could any man not love this kind of girl who takes care of the face of adolescent boys?
She couldn't help but applaud and said: "Sister, I always thought you were silly and sweet, but I didn't expect that your rank is quite high."
Liu Yingying said blankly: "What rank? I don't know how to play games."
"...It's okay, sister, please continue."
"As for me, I was a taciturn nerd at the time. Ye Fan was good at studying and handsome. Many girls liked him. They always came to trouble me after school. Once I was spotted by Ye Fan, and he picked me up and dropped me off on his bicycle every day."
"Later I found out that he scolded those girls severely and even secretly brought my favorite candied haws from outside the school. He was so stupid that he stained his clothes every time, which made me have to wash them for him."
"Sounds a bit romantic."
Liu Yiyi looked envious.
Woohoo, this damn sour smell of love!
"Romantic? Ye Fan is a straight man. He doesn't know how to send flowers or talk about love. All the love letters he wrote to me are triangles."
